readiness.hed: A sunny, mild Veterans Day afternoon gives way to patchy fog tonight and a light-rain chance Thursday
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service has no active alerts for Fredericksburg. Veterans Day stays sunny near 71 with a light southeast wind. Patchy fog develops overnight, a 50 percent rain chance arrives Thursday and Thursday night with less than a tenth of an inch expected, and colder northwest wind drops Friday's high to near 54 with gusts as high as 21 mph.
actions: Evening Veterans Day outdoor events stay weather-ready; expect falling temperatures after sunset.
Watch for reduced visibility from patchy fog late tonight into early Thursday morning.
Keep a light rain layer handy Thursday and Thursday night; expected rainfall stays under one tenth of an inch.
Secure light outdoor items before Friday as northwest gusts may reach 21 mph and the temperature falls.
